notes: SHIP v1.14.385 - PHASE 2: ACTIVE BUILD WORKSPACE (phone). Owner ruling 2026-08-05 fixed the phase names: Phase 1 = Responsive Command Shell, Phase 2 = Active Build Workspace. This ships Phase 2 phone. FIRST, THE HONEST FINDING THAT PRECEDED IT: the device-verify failure was NOT a mis-mounted renderer, a wrong host, a bad gate or a cache. The Phase 2 Build workspace had never been built. Traced end to end: the BUILD control is #bn-work (:16024) with onclick showMode('work'); showMode maps {command:'cmd',work:'work',ref:'ref'} and calls showPage('work') into the .page #pg-work; the DEPLOY/SCAN/HANDOFF stack has NO renderer at all - it is STATIC MARKUP inside #work-grid, the v1.14.359 BUILD BANNER ROWS whose handlers are deploy_quick / showWorkTab('scan') / handoff_quick; the host is #work-grid with wk_showGrid() restoring it; and no active-rack workspace function, no BUILD/FIELD MODE header and no hidden gate existed anywhere in the file. Ships .373 through .384 never touched #pg-work, so this was never a regression. WHAT LANDED: a new #bw-shell inside #pg-work rendered by bw_render(), gated on body.rd so it is the Build surface on the BARE URL and every redesign entry while ?legacy=1 keeps the untouched launcher. The legacy #work-grid is HIDDEN under body.rd via #pg-work.bw-on, never deleted - the rip-cord restores it. Structure per the approved phone reference: BUILD / FIELD MODE header, site context, honest LOCAL ACTIVE / ON-DEVICE state, Active Rack hero with real rack identifier and platform, real current phase and progress, CONTINUE, Next Action, the existing 3D rack preview, OPEN AISLE, the four metrics, and SCAN / PORT MAP / LOG BLOCKER over the persistent bottom nav. BUILD ROUTING implemented exactly as ruled: a BLOCKED rack outranks an in-flight one so the blocker surfaces; otherwise the in-progress rack; otherwise the first incomplete; deployment but no active rack falls to the rack queue; no Master falls to the Master intake door. NOT ONE VALUE IS HARDCODED. Rack identifier, platform, phase index, phase label and percentage all come from deploy_loadRacksFor, deploy_loadPhasesFor and deploy_computeRackRollup over DEPLOY_PHASE_TYPES. Blockers are counted from real phase status and the real blockerNote is surfaced. Next Action is the first unmet checklist item on the rack's current phase, falling back to the phase itself - never invented, never an estimate. Components, Connections and Verification render an honest em-dash when the local source is absent rather than a fabricated total; verified in the harness, where a seeded deployment with no hosts and no checklist items correctly showed three em-dashes and a real 0 blockers beside a real 'Phase 3 of 5 / NETWORK / 40%'. EVERY DOOR IS CANONICAL AND EXISTING: deploy_showRackDetail for CONTINUE and Next Action, forge3d_open for OPEN AISLE, showWorkTab('scan'), rd_openOpsTool('portmap'), blocker_quick, cmd_loadMaster. No new feature logic and no second entry point. THE 3D RACK IS THE EXISTING ONE, UNMODIFIED. rackElevation_render3D draws into a real measured box - never a display:contents ancestor, which is the .337 trap that collapses a WebGL mount. Scene internals are untouched: lighting, materials, fog, tone mapping, tray geometry, TYPE_COLORS, floor, reflection. It owns its own GL lifecycle and single-live-context guard. three.js lazy-loads from the SW-precached vendor copy; rackElevation_ensure3D could NOT be reused because it guards on #reh3dCanvasHost carrying .is-3d, which only the rack-detail panel has, so it would have bailed silently here - the Command hero's own lazy-load pattern is used instead, and every failure path states itself rather than leaving a blank box. OFFLINE-FIRST: nothing added here performs a network request, and the only new fetch is the already-precached three.min.js. Offline is stated positively as LOCAL ACTIVE / ON-DEVICE / FIELD MODE, never as failure. No new raw localStorage write path was added - this ship only READS state. TWO DEVIATIONS, BOTH DELIBERATE AND REPORTED. (1) The no-Master route renders the Build zero state with the canonical LOAD MASTER door as its primary action rather than auto-firing the intake modal, because live doctrine is that a Master flow never auto-launches; the door is one tap and nothing is hidden. (2) The FRONT / ISO / TOP / REAR and CABLES view rail is not yet inline on the preview card: rackElevation_render3D builds that rail only when the rack-detail panel's own toggle strip host is present, by an explicit guard, so reproducing it is a separate surgical commit rather than a change to the locked scene. Until then the full rail lives where it always has - CONTINUE opens deploy_showRackDetail, where FRONT/ISO/TOP/REAR, CABLES and EXPLODE all work today - and OPEN AISLE is on the card. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.385. (2) BARE URL, tap BUILD: the DEPLOY / SCAN / HANDOFF launcher must be GONE and the Build workspace must render. (3) With no Master it must read 'No Master loaded' with a LOAD MASTER button - that is correct, not a failure. (4) With a deployment and an active rack: real rack name, real phase, real percentage; any metric without local data must show an em-dash and never a number. (5) CONTINUE opens that rack's workflow. (6) SCAN, PORT MAP, LOG BLOCKER, OPEN AISLE all open their existing screens. (7) Airplane mode: BUILD still opens and the rack preview still draws. (8) ?legacy=1 still shows the untouched legacy Build launcher and RETURN TO NEW UI still works. (9) Phase 1 Command at ?shell=1 must be unchanged. NEXT IN THIS PROGRAM: the view rail inline on the preview card, then Phase 2 desktop inside the Phase 1 persistent shell, then the final integration release that makes the redesign default and retires ?shell=1.
